independent_reproduction.full_suite: 31 tests passed, 13.453 seconds; test setUp uses TemporaryDirectory stores and tiny fixture processes
independent_reproduction.capacity_one_release_without_result: Reproduced: while first hold-child was alive, forged release with missing result caused reserved=1, quarantined_integrity, exact error 'release record exists without its result', second job not dispatched, existing child remained alive.
independent_reproduction.orphan_release_without_reservation_or_re: Counterexample reproduced in a fresh temp store using hold-mode job: after inserting release.json before first tick (no reservation and no result), tick produced launch-intent and live child; returned status then labeled job quarantined_integrity with reserved=1 due release-without-result. This is a fail-closed violation: malformed artifact did not prevent launch.
independent_reproduction.cleanup: Fixture cleanup sent SIGKILL using pidfd to live child; immediate post-test process listing showed no remaining matching owner/supervisor process. The fixture cleanup does not wait for terminal/reap acknowledgment, so this is an observed cleanup, not a robust cleanup proof.

version_separation: V3 changes store schema from LocalExperimentQueueStoreV2 to V3, validates source roster, and has tests for V2/V3 cross-store refusal and mismatched preloaded module identities. V2 files were not modified. Other V3 modules are byte-identical to pinned V2 modules; V3 dispatcher source pin differs.
legitimate_paths: Existing tests exercise result-before-release reconciliation and deferred prelaunch result/release recovery; accepted executions require reservation, release, result linkage and executor terminal. These paths passed in full suite.

finding.description: The added invariant is enforced by verified_result, but tick skips that check for a job with no result and no reservation. An orphan release-only file can therefore be ignored by the prelaunch selection loop; V3 reserves and launches the attempt, then status quarantines it after reservation exists. The current test only covers orphan release together with a result (direct verified_result), so it misses release-only job state.
finding.needed_correction: Before any admission/dispatch of a job, scan/validate its release/reservation/result relationship. Any release without reservation must block/quarantine and consume no execution attempt; preserve existing capacity accounting and ensure no launch-intent/child is created. Add a hold-mode adversarial regression test.

recommendation: Do not treat the V3 invariant as complete or adopt V3 until the release-only prelaunch gap is fixed and retested. Existing missing-result-with-live-reservation behavior is supported.
